source.coverage_review: Third-party cn-division commit 88f2021ea21769bdb95d93699d8a625fcd9165ef, MIT. The raw snapshot envelope is derived; inputs preserve exact upstream bytes and SHA256. Commit date is not official effective date. 34 provinces supplemented from official sources; true prefecture/county types retained; 5 virtual municipality layers and 84 township/street rows excluded with audit trail. Province short forms and exact terminal 市/区/县 removal only for known true types are materialized offline as reviewed aliases; all cross-level conflicts retained. All 367 province/prefecture identities (including 297 supported P1 city targets (293 prefecture cities and four municipalities)) individually match independent official historical full-table evidence plus verified Laiwu removal/Nagqu reclassification, with zero missing/extra/different identities; official 2024 counts corroborate. This is not a freshly published 2026 official nationwide full table. County auxiliaries are upstream third-party data, not independently officially verified; they provide auxiliary type evidence for unsupported inputs; runtime city matching ignores cross-level aliases outside the supported city set. See official_verification/comparison_report.json and EVIDENCE.md.
